sanskrit_verse:
अपि भ्राता सुतोऽर्घ्यो वा श्वशुरो मातुरोऽपि वा ।
नादण्ड्यो नाम राज्ञोऽस्ति धर्माद् विचलितः स्वकात् ॥
transliteration: api bhrātā suto 'rghyo vā śvaśuro māturo 'pi vā / nādaṇḍyo nāma rājño 'sti dharmād vicalitaḥ svakāt //
sph_interpretive_translation: Even a brother, son, father, or maternal grandfather—none who have strayed from their own Dharma shall be exempt from correction by the King.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from alignment with Dharma, not bloodline
Causation arises from deviation from Svadharma, not social status
Capacity-based responsibility applies universally, regardless of relation
Restoration logic requires correction aligned with Dharma, not lineage
Consciousness alignment supersedes familial or societal privilege
executable_legal_axioms: IF relation_to_ruler EXISTS THEN NO exemption_from_dharmic_accountability
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, no familial or hierarchical proximity to authority exempts one from Dharmic realignment. The threshold for responsibility lies solely in the degree of deviation from Sva-Dharma, not relational status.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that misalignment from Svadharma creates sequential disorder (anupūrvaśaḥ). Correction is proportional to the deviation and aimed at restoring consciousness integrity—not inflicting punishment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process to restore actor's Sva-Dharma alignment
Assign responsibility assumption protocol under royal guidance
Engage consciousness reintegration through Dharmic practice
Verify restoration through behavioral and spiritual realignment metrics
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the sole Source of Law: Dharma transcends relation; accountability flows from alignment, not ancestry; justice restores consciousness, not vengeance. Thus is Dharma executed.
